input.summary: Make the mutual cap the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, restore the Excluded Claims carve-outs, and make the payment carve-out cover all amounts due.
input.comment: [Playbook] A one-month cap applying "without exception" is below our walk-away floor and cancels the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2-21.3, so we set the mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 and reinstated the Excluded Claims exception (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement stay uncapped). We also broadened the payment carve-out from narrowly defined "Fees" to amounts due, keeping the undisputed/conforming qualifiers.

ops.oldText: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
undisputed amounts due for conforming Services
